title: Limits of sheaves of sets on a site are computed sectionwise
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site in the sense of Stacks Sites, Definition 00VH [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (1), and $\Sh(\mathcal C)$ its category of sheaves of sets (functors $\mathcal F:\mathcal C^{op}\to$ sets such that $\mathcal F(U)\to\prod_i\mathcal F(U_i)\rightrightarrows\prod_{i,j}\mathcal F(U_i\times_UU_j)$ is an equalizer for every covering $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$; morphisms the natural transformations). Let $\mathcal I$ be a small category (e.g. a finite one) and $M:\mathcal I\to\Sh(\mathcal C)$, $i\mapsto\mathcal F_i$, a diagram. Then: (1) the presheaf $\mathcal L:U\mapsto\lim_{i\in\mathcal I}\mathcal F_i(U)$ (limit of sets; restriction maps induced by those of the $\mathcal F_i$), with the projections $p_i:\mathcal L\to\mathcal F_i$, is a sheaf of sets, and $(\mathcal L,(p_i)_i)$ is a limit of $M$ in $\Sh(\mathcal C)$ (and in the category of presheaves of sets); (2) consequently a cone $(\mathcal F,(q_i:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F_i)_i)$ over $M$ in $\Sh(\mathcal C)$ is a limit cone in $\Sh(\mathcal C)$ if and only if for every object $U$ of $\mathcal C$ the cone of sets $(\mathcal F(U),(q_{i,U})_i)$ is a limit cone of $i\mapsto\mathcal F_i(U)$, i.e. the map $\mathcal F(U)\to\lim_i\mathcal F_i(U)$, $s\mapsto(q_{i,U}(s))_i$, is bijective.

source.place: Sites, Lemma Tag 00W2 (lemma-limit-sheaf, line 1680) and its proof (the limit presheaf is a sheaf, hence a limit in Sh(C)); clause (2) follows from (1) by uniqueness of limits up to unique isomorphism of cones
